source: Illustrative worked example, Everpure Tech Atlas Ch6 model (not vendor data): rebuild hours = capacity / effective rebuild write rate. Single-spare: HDD 200 MB/s, SSD 1 GB/s (throttled under production load). Declustered: 100 surviving drives each contributing 50 MB/s (HDD) or 0.5 GB/s (SSD) of reconstructed output; with 8+2 stripes that needs 8x as much read bandwidth (e.g. 4 GB/s read per SSD). Capacities: Seagate 30 TB Exos M (PetaPixel 2024-01-18); Solidigm 122.88 TB; Micron 6600 ION 245.76 TB (Micron IR 2026-05-05); 300 TB-class module (Blocks & Files 2026-08-11)
